sentences.en: Her coloring book lay limp, jagged with angular pink scribbles.
sentences.zh: 她的彩色画册软趴趴地摊着，上面是不规则的粉红色涂鸦。

sentences.en: I couldn't help noticing that you seem to be limping.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住注意到你好像有点瘸。

sentences.en: She has sagging tits and her husband has a limp noodle.
sentences.zh: 她胸部下垂，而她丈夫则是个‘软蛋’。

senses.zh: 瘸着脚走，跛行；进展缓慢，艰难地行进
柔软的，不直挺的；无力的，无精神的
